conventions.units: metres (ASF units x (1/0.45) x 2.54/100 = 0.056444, CMU FAQ)
conventions.axes: BVH and FBX: right-handed, Y up, rest pose faces +Z, character left = +X. Blender import/export use axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y both ways, so FBX coordinates equal BVH coordinates.
conventions.fps: 30 (every 4th frame of the 120 Hz capture, no filtering)
conventions.skeleton: CMU ASF bone names, 31 bones, one bone per ASF bone; bone i starts at the end of its parent (root children lhipjoint/rhipjoint/lowerback start at the pelvis centre). Rest orientation of every BVH joint is identity (world aligned); local rotation = C*M*C^-1.
conventions.root_motion: kept (real displacement); each clip rigidly aligned, see alignment.
conventions.rest_pose: BOTH: (1) separate cmu_<subject>_rest.fbx per subject (one frame, ASF rest pose with the root lifted so the ankles sit at the measured standing ankle height); (2) every clip FBX also has the ASF rest pose as its static node transforms (keyed at Blender frame -1, outside the exported take, scene parked there during export), while the take itself holds only motion frames 0..N-1. Verified by re-importing each FBX in Blender (rest error column).
conventions.fbx_export: armature only, add_leaf_bones=False, primary/secondary bone axis Y/X (defaults), apply_unit_scale=True, apply_scale_options=FBX_SCALE_ALL, bake_anim_use_all_actions=False, one take named after the clip id, bake step 1, simplify 0.05
conventions.rest_pose_shape: ASF rest = arms horizontal (T), legs splayed ~20 deg outwards (femur direction (+-0.342, -0.940, 0)), feet forward. [Unverified] Unity may want Enforce T-Pose in the avatar configure step because of the splayed legs.
conventions.unity_notes_unverified: [Unverified: not opened in Unity] Rig=Humanoid; avatar from cmu_<subject>_rest.fbx (Copy From Other Avatar) for the clips of that subject. Likely mapping: Hips=root, Upper/Lower Leg=l/rfemur, l/rtibia, Foot=l/rfoot, Toes=l/rtoes, Spine=upperback (lowerback starts at the hips position), Chest=thorax, Neck=lowerneck, Head=head, Shoulder=l/rclavicle, Upper/Lower Arm=l/rhumerus, l/rradius, Hand=l/rwrist.
